title: Must See Broadway Shows
article:
1. SIX

Henry IIIV’s 6 wives rocking out together on Broadway for 4 years in New York! It tells the story of Henry IIIV’s 6 wives’ lives, their tragic deaths, their divorces, and the story of their married lives. This show is does not only have an interesting plot but it also has amazing musical hits such as “Ex-Wives” and “Six”.



2. Wicked

If you’ve ever watched or read of the Wizard of Oz, you’ll love Wicked. It follows the story of the Wicked Witch of the West or Elphaba and the Good Witch of the South or Glinda as they explore friendship and go on an adventure to Oz.



3. Hamilton

Hamilton tells the story of Alexander Hamilton, an orphan who became the right hand man to George Washington, our first president.



2. Suffs

Suffs follows the story of 5 sufferjets (people fighting for women’s rights) as they fight and fight for their rights. They face many challenges and unlike their fellow sufferjets start thinking peaceful protest isn’t the way to rights.



1. Water for Elephants

A show about someone who joins a traveling circus. This broadway show travels from past to present as Jacob Jankowski, an old man, tells his story as a circus performer when he was younger.
author: Sabine Shulimovich
